title: jurinea humilis var. bocconei
intro: Jurinea humilis var. bocconei, commonly known as Dwarf Jurinea, is a plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammatory diseases, due to its reported health benefits, such as reducing inflammation and improving wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Jurinea humilis var. bocconei include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Jurinea humilis var. bocconei include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
